title: 第1章 宋家选宅
slug: 驱鬼道长全本免费-驱鬼道长最新章节列表
content_zh:
土生土长的东北人，职业道士，放到现在，人们都称呼我为神棍。
我师从蒋正心，是继承他的衣钵才走上神棍的这条路。
但值得一提，师傅原来并干这行，他小的时候给地主家放牛，是个放牛娃，至于改行做道士，还有一个故事。
这一切，都要从大柳村宋家选阴宅说起…………
清朝末年，民国初期，平阳县，大柳村有一户姓宋的大人家。
在那个封建的年代，宋家可谓是当地十里八村有名的大地主。
话说，当时的宋家钱财万贯，良田百倾，佣人无数，不过唯独祖上没有出过大官。
这一年正赶上老夫人过世，宋老爷一合计，就让自己儿子去找了一位姓马的道士，打算让他选一处风水宝.穴，将自己的老伴葬在那里，也好让宋家出个大官，光宗耀祖。
宋家请来的这个道士叫马真人，据说，他还是古代方仙道的传人。
不过可惜，方仙道到了他这代几乎已经断了香火传承，他也流落成了一名野道士，靠着看命算卦为生。
在当地，一般人家有解决不掉的小难题和小麻烦都会请他来办，例如哪家的孩子丢了魂，哪家的人撞了邪，他都能出手解决，因此在当地也算是小有名气的一个人。
而且据当地人传言，他手里还有一处能出将相的好.穴.位，宋老爷也正是看中他手中的穴.位，才将其请过来。
马真人被请到宋家，宋老爷并没有急于说出目的，先是好酒好菜招待他，待到酒过三巡之后，宋老爷见马真人醉意朦胧，便拿出一锭银子放在桌上，开口道:
“马真人，宋某可是久仰你的大名了，这次把你请过来，是想让你替我宋家选一处好.穴.位。”
俗话说吃人手软，拿人手短，马真人酒喝的醉醺醺，接过银子，拍着胸脯保证，说这事简单啊，我手里正好有一口好.穴，如果将你夫人的阴宅坐在此.穴的周围之处，保你宋家财源滚滚，福荫百代。
宋老爷见多识广，对于风水阴宅之说也耳濡目染过一些，他摆了摆手，对马真人说：“我们宋家的钱财已然够多，几代都挥霍不完，唯独历代没有出现过大官，据我听说，你手上的那处穴.位能出将相，所以我要将夫人的尸骨葬在此.穴的正中心之处，以此地真龙之气滋养，保我宋家后代能出大官。”
马真人听完面色为之一变，他放下酒杯，头摇的像个拨浪鼓，忙说道:“东家，不可，不可，你有所不知，将夫人的尸骨葬在此.穴周围尚可，如果硬要葬在穴.位中心，我的道行不够，恐怕镇压不住此.穴的真龙之气，一旦遭到反噬，那我可是要瘸腿瞎眼的。”
也不怪马真人担心，选阴宅就流传着一个规矩，一般像这种能出将相的大.穴.位，如果道行不够，千万不能冒然将尸骨葬在中心穴.位，顶多就是偏离一些下葬，沾染一些真龙之气，福荫后代就行了。
如果硬要葬在中心位置，除非施法之人的道行足够深，不然的话，就会受到穴.位的真龙之气反噬，轻则腿脚残疾，重则双目尽瞎。
这也是为什么许多阴阳先生，算命之人多为瘸子，瞎子，他们大多都是为了钱财，泄露天机遭到报应，这选阴宅也一样，本是为东家逆天改运之事，如果修为，德行不够深厚，也会遭到报应。

所以，一般的风水先生给东家点穴.位，从来都不点正位，全都偏离穴位中心安置尸骨。
这个马真人的道行显然不够，镇压不住此穴位。
话又说回来，要是他道行高深的话，也不会流落成一名野道士，连一座像样的道观都没有了。
但宋老爷子听完则不以为然，心说不就是选个阴宅吗？哪有你说的那么严重？难道，这马真人嫌弃我给的银子少？
这般想着，宋老爷又自怀里拿出一钉银子放在桌子上，说道:“马真人，这是一点小意思，请你笑纳，你无论如何也要帮我宋家一次啊。”
马真人并没有伸手接银子，只是一脸苦笑的说道:“东家，你以为我在骗你？我说的都是真的，如果将夫人的尸骨葬在宝.穴的周围，这银子我收下，如果硬要葬在中心位置，这银子你还是拿回去吧！”
为了宋家后代能出现大官，光宗耀祖，宋老爷怎么会轻易放弃，他想了想，说道:马真人，我看你老一大把年纪，以后也没有力气走江湖了，这样，你就帮我宋家一次，你的大恩大德宋家不敢忘记，如果你真的瘸腿瞎了双眼，我宋家便养你后半辈子如何？到时你留在宋家，吃喝我供着你，我还让犬子为你养老送终！”

content_en:
A native of the Northeast and a professional Taoist priest, people still call me the magic stick.
I studied under Jiang Zhengxin, and it was only after inheriting his legacy that I embarked on the path of being a magic stick.
But it is worth mentioning that the master did not work in this profession before. When he was a child, he herded cattle for the landlord's family and was a cowherd boy. As for his change of profession and becoming a Taoist priest, there is another story.
All of this starts with the Song family’s choice of a haunted house in Daliu Village...
At the end of the Qing Dynasty and the beginning of the Republic of China, there was a family named Song in Daliu Village, Pingyang County.
In that feudal era, the Song family was a famous landowner in eight villages in the area.
In other words, at that time, the Song family had a lot of money, fertile land, and countless servants, but none of their ancestors had ever had a high official.
This year coincided with the death of the old lady. Master Song made a plan and asked his son to find a Taoist priest named Ma, planning to let him choose a feng shui treasure cave and bury his wife there, so that the Song family could have a high official and honor the ancestors.
The Taoist priest invited by the Song family is called Ma Zhenren. It is said that he is also the successor of the ancient Fangxian Taoism.
Unfortunately, Fang Xiandao has almost stopped the incense inheritance in his generation, and he has become a wild Taoist priest, making a living by fortune telling.
In the local area, most people will ask him to deal with small problems and troubles that cannot be solved. For example, if a child of a family has lost his soul or a member of a family has an evil spirit, he can solve it. Therefore, he is also a somewhat famous person in the local area.
Moreover, according to local rumors, he also had a good acupuncture point in his hand that could produce generals. Mr. Song also invited him over because he took a fancy to the acupoint in his hand.
Master Ma was invited to the Song family. Mr. Song was not in a hurry to tell him the purpose. He first entertained him with good wine and delicious food. After three drinks, Master Song saw that Mr. Ma was drunk, so he took out a silver coin and put it on the table and said:
"Master Ma, Mr. Song has admired your name for a long time. I invited you here this time because I want you to choose a good acupuncture point for my Song family."
As the saying goes, eating people is soft and taking people is short-handed. Ma Zhenren was drunk with wine. He took the silver and patted his chest and promised, saying this is simple. I happen to have a good hole in my hand. If your wife's shady house is placed around this hole, I will ensure that your Song family will be rich and prosperous for generations.
Mr. Song was well-informed and had some familiarity with the theory of Feng Shui and Yin House. He waved his hand and said to Master Ma: "Our Song family already has enough money, and we have been squandering it for several generations, but there has been no appearance in the past generations." If you want to be a high official, I heard that the acupuncture point on your hand can produce a general, so I want to bury my wife's body in the center of this acupoint, and nourish it with the true dragon's energy to ensure that the descendants of my Song family will be able to become a high official."
After hearing this, Master Ma's expression changed. He put down his wine glass, shook his head like a rattle, and said hurriedly: "My boss, no, no, you don't know something. It's okay to bury my wife's bones around this hole. If I insist on burying her bones in the center of the hole, I'm not good enough. I'm afraid I won't be able to suppress the true dragon's energy in this hole. Once it gets backlash, I will be lame and blind."
It’s no wonder that Master Ma is worried. There is a rule in choosing the Yin House. Generally, large acupuncture points like this can produce generals. If the Taoism is not good enough, you must not rashly bury the bones in the central acupoint. At most, you can bury some deviations and be tainted with some true dragon energy, so as to bless future generations.
If you insist on being buried in the center, unless the person who casts the spell has deep enough Taoism, otherwise, the true dragon's energy in the acupuncture point will backfire, which can range from disabled legs and feet to complete blindness in the worst case.
This is why many Yin Yang gentlemen and fortune tellers are mostly lame or blind. Most of them do it for money and reveal the secrets of heaven and receive retribution. The same is true for choosing a Yin Yang house. It is originally a matter of changing the fortune of the owner against heaven. If you cultivate yourself and your virtue is not deep enough, you will also receive retribution.
Therefore, the average Feng Shui master will give the owner some acupuncture points., never click on the correct position, and always place the bones away from the center of the acupuncture point.
Master Ma's Taoism is obviously not good enough to suppress this acupuncture point.
Then again, if he had a profound Taoist practice, he wouldn't have become a wild Taoist priest without even a decent Taoist temple.
But Mr. Song didn't think so after hearing this. He thought to himself, "Isn't it just a matter of choosing a ghost house?" How can it be as serious as you say? Could it be that Master Ma dislikes the small amount of money I gave him?
With this thought in mind, Mr. Song took out a nail of silver from his pocket and put it on the table, saying, "Master Ma, this is a small thing. Please accept it. You have to help the Song family no matter what."
Master Ma did not reach out to take the silver, but said with a wry smile: "My boss, do you think I am lying to you? What I said is true. If the wife's bones are buried around the treasure cave, I will accept the money. If you insist on burying it in the center, you should take the money back!"
In order for the descendants of the Song family to have high officials and honor their ancestors, how could Mr. Song give up so easily? He thought about it and said: Master Ma, I see that you are much older and will not have the strength to travel in the world in the future. In this way, you can help the Song family once. The Song family dare not forget your great kindness. If you are really lame and blind, how about our Song family will support you for the rest of your life? When the time comes, you stay in the Song family, and I will provide for you with food and drink, and I will also let Quanzi take care of you until you die! "
